AdFree reads @match, @include, @exclude, @run-at and @noframes, and fetches @require when installing from a URL (a manually imported file keeps its content as-is; @require is not fetched). Supports unsafeWindow, GM_addStyle, GM_log, GM_info, GM_xmlhttpRequest/GM_download (following the page\'s CORS), GM_openInTab, GM_notification, GM_setClipboard and GM_addElement; GM_setValue and @resource are not supported.
